mapper.select: SELECT ub.*, b.badge_id, b.category, b.sub_category, b.name, b.description, b.target_value, b.image_url, b.gray_image_url, b.tier FROM user_badges ub JOIN badges b ON ub.badge_id = b.badge_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ub.*, b.badge_id, b.category, b.sub_category, b.name, b.description, b.target_value, b.image_url, b.gray_image_url, b.tier FROM user_badges ub JOIN badges b ON ub.badge_id = b.badge_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.badge_id = #{badgeId}
